eyebrow: Why it's unbiased: the proof sketch
code:
E[grad log(pi) * b(s)] = b(s) * sum_a grad(pi(a|s))
                       = b(s) * grad( sum_a pi(a|s) )
                       = b(s) * grad(1)      <- probabilities sum to 1
                       = 0
caption: Because action probabilities always sum to 1, this term is always exactly zero
